purpose: Machine-readable boundary between authoritative inputs, derived engineering products, presentation assets, and runtime evidence.
engineeringRules: Observations, forecasts, calculations, simulations, evidence, and regulatory references remain distinct data classes.
SHA-256 establishes integrity of recorded bytes; it does not establish scientific truth or legal admissibility.
Vertical datum remains dataset-declared unless an explicit, versioned transformation is recorded.
Derived artifacts identify material inputs and the software/model version used to create them.
Presentation data never becomes authoritative merely because it is rendered.
No authoritative record is synthesized from missing source metadata.
Rejected or quarantined records cannot be promoted into runtime evidence.
Connected telemetry is a separate runtime mode and cannot silently activate in Sovereign Mode.
